title: Do What You Say: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models via Runtime Reasoning-Action Alignment Verification
authors_zh: Yilin Wu、Anqi Li、Tucker Hermans、Fabio Ramos、Andrea Bajcsy、Claudia Pérez-D'Arpino
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: SEAL simulates candidate actions and selects the sequence best aligned with the VLA's textual plan.
SEAL 先模拟候选动作，再选出与视觉语言动作模型文字计划最一致的动作序列。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）
why: It separately audits reasoning text, predicted physical outcome, and selected actions.
inclusion_reason: Embodied text-plan/simulation/alignment fields form a direct Track 5 trace-selection contract.

title: Problem
问题
html: Reasoning VLAs can produce a plausible textual subgoal and still execute actions whose physical outcome does not match that plan, especially under visual, linguistic, or compositional distribution shift. SEAL calls this the embodied chain-of-thought faithfulness gap. The data problem has two parts: constructing segment-level textual plans aligned to robot demonstrations, and representing runtime candidate action sequences together with predicted outcomes and a semantic alignment decision.
推理型 VLA 可能生成合理的文本子目标，却执行出与该计划不一致的物理结果；在视觉、语言或组合式分布偏移下，这一问题更明显。SEAL 将其称为具身思维链忠实性缺口。对应的数据问题包括两部分：为机器人示范构建与动作片段对齐的文本计划，以及记录运行时候选动作序列、预测结果和语义对齐判断。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: SEAL first annotates LIBERO demonstrations with a changing reasoning state—an overall plan, completed subgoals, and the next subgoal—and fine-tunes a reasoning VLA that switches between text and action generation. At runtime, each newly generated text plan conditions multiple variable-length candidate action sequences. Parallel simulation predicts their outcomes, and an off-the-shelf VLM judges whether each predicted final state fulfills the plan. The selected sequence is executed without additional policy training.
SEAL 先为 LIBERO 示范标注随执行进度变化的推理状态，包括完整计划、已完成子目标和下一子目标，并微调可在文本与动作生成之间切换的推理型 VLA。运行时，每个新文本计划都会条件化生成多条变长候选动作序列；并行仿真预测其结果，现成 VLM 判断候选末态是否实现计划，随后执行通过选择的序列，无需再训练策略。

title: Method
方法
html:
Gemini receives a demonstration video and its high-level instruction, then jointly proposes one-sentence subtask plans and their end timesteps. The authors report manually verifying all generated annotations. Each reasoning record follows three fields: Plans, What has been done, and Now I need to do. The released LIBERO-R package contains libero-10-r, libero-100-basket-r, and libero-100-r; each includes episode data and metadata, while cot_simple.json indexes reasoning segments by episode and stores start/end steps plus current and updated textual content.

The reasoning VLA is trained with named think and act control tokens, cross-entropy loss for text, and flow-matching loss for actions. During SEAL inference, the policy autoregressively samples candidate action sequences until it emits the next think control token. Parallel LIBERO instances predict the resulting observation sequence. GPT-4o acts as a proxy verifier and receives the episode's initial image, the candidate's predicted final image, and the current text plan; it returns a binary alignment judgment. The implementation can execute the first asynchronously verified candidate rather than waiting for every candidate. Exact candidate count is experiment-dependent; real-world use would require a sufficiently accurate simulator, learned world model, or digital twin.

Gemini 接收示范视频和高层任务指令，同时生成一句话子任务计划及其结束时间步；论文称所有生成标注均经过人工核验。每条推理记录包含 Plans、What has been done 和 Now I need to do 三部分。公开的 LIBERO-R 包含 libero-10-r、libero-100-basket-r 和 libero-100-r；各目录含 episode 数据与元数据，cot_simple.json 则按 episode 索引推理片段，记录起止步骤、当前文本状态和更新后的文本内容。

推理型 VLA 使用命名的 think 与 act 控制 token 在文本和动作间切换，文本采用交叉熵损失，动作采用 flow-matching 损失。SEAL 推理时，策略自回归采样候选动作序列，直到输出下一枚 think 控制 token；并行 LIBERO 实例预测后续观察。GPT-4o 作为代理验证器，只接收 episode 初始图像、候选预测末帧和当前文本计划，并返回二值对齐判断。实现可异步执行首条通过验证的候选，而不等待全部候选完成。候选数随实验设置变化；若用于真实机器人，还需足够准确的仿真器、学习型世界模型或数字孪生。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper and official release establish the annotation format, three LIBERO-R variants, episode/segment linkage, training switches, simulation-backed candidate generation, and VLM alignment check. The authors report manual review of generated reasoning annotations, which is direct process evidence, although the per-item review record and disagreement protocol are not public.

LIBERO success rates, OOD comparisons, and runtime-scaling results evaluate the trained policy and steering procedure. They do not validate every annotation or VLM judgment. The official repository exposes code and data, but its README still lists pretrained checkpoints as forthcoming; the checkpoint release boundary should therefore remain unknown until separately verified.

论文与官方发布可核实标注格式、三种 LIBERO-R 变体、episode—片段关联、训练切换机制、基于仿真的候选生成和 VLM 对齐检查。作者称生成的推理标注全部经过人工复核，这属于直接的过程证据；但逐条审核记录和分歧处理协议并未公开。

LIBERO 成功率、OOD 对比与运行时扩展结果评估的是训练后策略和 steering 流程，不能验证每条标注或每次 VLM 判断。官方仓库已公开代码与数据，但 README 仍把预训练检查点列为待发布，因此在另行核验前，权重发布边界应保持 unknown。

title: Novelty
新意
html: SEAL makes plan–action faithfulness an explicit runtime verification contract. Unlike a critic that scores short action chunks for generic progress, its verifier compares the predicted outcome of a complete plan-conditioned sequence against the model’s own current subgoal. The accompanying LIBERO-R release also exposes a reusable segment schema linking demonstration timesteps to evolving textual plans. The method is best-of-N steering with a learned semantic proxy, not a proof-producing safety verifier.
SEAL 把计划—动作忠实性明确化为运行时验证契约。不同于只为短动作块评估一般进度的 critic，它比较一条完整、由计划条件化的动作序列之预测结果与模型当前子目标。配套 LIBERO-R 还公开了可复用的片段模式，把示范时间步与不断更新的文本计划关联起来。该方法属于使用学习型语义代理的 best-of-N steering，并不是能够产生形式化证明的安全验证器。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Selection is bounded by the base policy: if no viable action sequence is sampled, verification cannot recover one. GPT-4o can misjudge fine-grained gripper interactions, wrist-camera views, or occluded scenes, and plan alignment is not equivalent to whole-task success or safety. Simulation or world-model error can change the candidate ranking; sampling and verification add latency and external-model cost.

For the released data, exact episode counts, source-license inheritance, annotation prompts/revisions, reviewer identities, rejection records, inter-reviewer checks, and a record-level provenance ledger are not fully documented on the dataset page. OOD environment versions and immutable replay fixtures also need pinning. Pretrained checkpoint availability remains unknown from the current repository README.

选择上限受基础策略约束：如果候选集中没有可行动作序列，验证器无法凭空恢复。GPT-4o 可能误判精细夹爪交互、腕部相机视角或严重遮挡场景；计划对齐也不等同于完整任务成功或安全。仿真器/世界模型误差会改变候选排序，采样与验证还增加延迟和外部模型成本。

对公开数据而言，数据页没有完整披露精确 episode 数、上游许可继承、标注提示及版本、审核者信息、拒绝记录、审核一致性检查和逐记录来源账本。OOD 环境版本与不可变回放工件也需要固定。按当前仓库 README，预训练检查点是否可得仍为 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: LIBERO-R is directly useful for studying segment-level embodied reasoning because it links task instructions, robot episodes, timestep intervals, progress summaries, and next-subgoal text. SEAL additionally provides a schema for logging runtime steering: candidate action sequences, simulator/world-model revision, predicted terminal images, verifier prompt and model revision, binary judgments, latency, selected sequence, executed outcome, and task terminal state. Keeping these fields separate prevents semantic alignment from being mistaken for success or safety.
LIBERO-R 可直接用于研究片段级具身推理，因为它关联任务指令、机器人 episode、时间步区间、进度摘要与下一子目标文本。SEAL 还提供运行时 steering 的记录模式：候选动作序列、仿真器/世界模型版本、预测末帧、验证提示与模型版本、二值判断、延迟、选中序列、实际执行结果和任务终止状态。分开保存这些字段，可避免把语义对齐误当成成功或安全。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Distinguish the released LIBERO-R reasoning annotations from runtime candidate-action rollouts.
  • The annotation fields describe plan progress; they are not action-success labels by themselves.
  • The VLM checks predicted outcome–plan alignment, not global task success or robot safety.
  • “Training-free” applies to runtime steering, not to construction of the underlying reasoning VLA.
  • Pin dataset, simulator, verifier, prompt, and checkpoint revisions for replay.

• 区分已发布的 LIBERO-R 推理标注与运行时候选动作 rollout。
  • 标注字段描述计划进度，本身不是动作成功标签。
  • VLM 检查预测结果与计划的对齐，而不是全局任务成功或机器人安全。
  • “Training-free” 指运行时 steering，不代表底层推理型 VLA 无需训练。
  • 回放时应固定数据集、仿真器、验证器、提示和检查点版本。
